title: 연말정산 문의하기: 뭘 내고, 얼마나 돌려받아요?
objective: Ask about year-end tax documents and use 에 따라.
summary: A foreign employee asks HR what to submit for year-end tax settlement.
setting: The HR office at a Korean company in January. Mark, a foreign employee, is doing year-end tax settlement (연말정산) for the first time and asks the person in charge.

task.title: Use the tax expressions
task.line: Use the dialogue, the word list, and N + 에 따라 ("depending on N") to complete each item.

words.meaning: year-end tax settlement (done through your employer)
words.exampleMeaning: This is my first year-end tax settlement, so I don't really know how it works.
Can education costs be deducted too?

words.meaning: the simplified tax data file (your spending records collected online)
words.example: 간소화 자료에 안경 산 게 빠져 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: The glasses I bought are missing from my simplified tax data.

words.example: 은행 앱에서 이체 내역을 확인해 보세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Check your transfer records in the bank app.

words.meaning: to ask (polite form of 물어보다, used with seniors or staff)
words.exampleMeaning: If you don't know something, ask the person in charge.

dialogue.korean: 저, 연말정산 때문에 여쭤볼 게 있는데요. 지금 시간 괜찮으세요?
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, I have a question about year-end tax settlement. Do you have a minute?

dialogue.korean: 네. 작년에 낸 세금을 돌려받을 수도 있다고 들었는데, 저도 받을 수 있나요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes. I heard I might get back some of the tax I paid last year. Can I get some back too?

dialogue.korean: 그건 사람에 따라 달라요. 1년 동안 쓴 돈에 따라 더 돌려받을 수도 있고, 오히려 더 내야 할 수도 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: That depends on the person. Depending on what you spent during the year, you may get money back, or you may actually have to pay more.

dialogue.korean: 아, 그렇군요. 그럼 저는 뭘 내야 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I see. Then what do I need to submit?

dialogue.korean: 홈택스에서 간소화 자료를 내려받아서 회사에 내시면 돼요. 카드 사용 내역이나 병원비가 거기 다 나와요.
dialogue.meaning: Download your simplified tax data from Hometax and give it to the company. Your card spending and medical bills are all shown there.
Is monthly rent included too? I live in a studio apartment.

dialogue.korean: 월세는 조건에 따라 공제가 될 수도 있어요. 그런데 간소화 자료에는 안 나와서 집 계약서하고 이체 내역을 따로 내셔야 해요.
dialogue.meaning: Rent may be deductible, depending on the conditions. But it doesn't show up in the simplified data, so you need to send your lease and your transfer records separately.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the pattern from the dialogue: 필요한 서류는 상황____ 달라요.
Choose the right word: 은행 앱에서 월세를 보낸 (계약서 / 이체 내역)을 캡처했어요.
Write in Korean: You want to politely ask the HR staff if you can ask them something. Use 여쭤보다.
Answer in Korean based on the dialogue: 마크는 월세 공제를 받으려면 무엇을 따로 내야 해요?
answers: 에 따라 (상황에 따라 달라요) (also correct: 에 따라서)
뭐 하나 여쭤봐도 될까요? (also correct: 하나 여쭤봐도 돼요? / 여쭤볼 게 있는데요.)
집 계약서하고 이체 내역을 따로 내야 해요.
